This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if del usuario last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and del usuario protection was broken. Fails if el usuario moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for del usuario side.

Wild Charge.description: If al objetivo lost PS, el usuario takes recoil damage equal to 1/4 the PS lost by al objetivo, redondeado hacia arriba, but not less than 1 PS.

Wildbolt Storm.description: Tiene un 20% de probabilidad de paralizar al objetivo. If the weather is Primordial Sea or Rain Dance, this move does not check accuracy. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 80%.

Wish.description: At the end of the next turn, the Pokemon at del usuario position has 1/2 of del usuario maximum PS restored to it, redondeado hacia abajo. Fails if this move is already in effect for del usuario position.

Withdraw.description: Aumenta la Defensa del usuario en 1 nivel(es).

Wonder Room.description: For 5 turns, all active Pokemon have their Defensa and Defensa Especial stats swapped. Stat stage changes are unaffected. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.

Wood Hammer.description: If al objetivo lost PS, el usuario takes recoil damage equal to 33% the PS lost by al objetivo, redondeado hacia arriba, but not less than 1 PS.

Work Up.description: Raises del usuario Ataque and Ataque Especial by 1 stage.

Worry Seed.description: Causes del objetivo Ability to become Insomnia. Fails if del objetivo Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Insomnia, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

Wrap.description: Prevents al objetivo from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if el usuario is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to al objetivo equal to 1/8 of its maximum PS (1/6 if el usuario is holding Binding Band), redondeado hacia abajo, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still retirarse if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either el usuario or al objetivo leaves the field, or if al objetivo uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

Wring Out.description: Power is equal to 120 * (target's current PS / target's maximum PS), redondeado hacia abajo, but not less than 1.

Yawn.description: Causes al objetivo to fall asleep at the end of the next turn. Fails when used if al objetivo cannot fall asleep or if it already has a non-volatile problema de estado. At the end of the next turn, if al objetivo is still active, does not have a non-volatile problema de estado, and can fall asleep, it falls asleep. If al objetivo becomes affected, this effect cannot be prevented by Safeguard or a substitute, or by falling asleep and waking up during the effect.

Zap Cannon.description: Tiene un 100% de probabilidad de paralizar al objetivo.

Zen Headbutt.description: Has a 20% chance to make al objetivo retroceder.

Zing Zap.description: Has a 30% chance to make al objetivo retroceder.

Zippy Zap.description: Has a 100% chance to raise del usuario evasion by 1 stage.

Adaptability.description: Los movimientos de este Pokémon que coinciden con su tipo tienen una bonificación STAB de 2 en lugar de 1.5.

Aerilate.description: De este Pokémon Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

Aftermath.description: If este Pokémon es debilitado with a movimiento de contacto, that move's user loses 1/4 of its maximum PS, redondeado hacia abajo. This effect is prevented if the move's user has the Magic Guard Ability or if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.

Analytic.description: The power of de este Pokémon move is multiplied by 1.3 if it is the last to move in a turn. Does not affect Doom Desire and Future Sight.

Anger Point.description: If este Pokémon, but not its substitute, is struck by a golpe crítico, its Ataque is raised by 12 stages.

Anticipation.description: On switch-in, este Pokémon is alerted if any opposing Pokemon has an attacking move with a type that is super effective against este Pokémon, or any OHKO move. This effect considers Hidden Power to be its determined type, and every other move to be its original type.

Armor Tail.description: Priority moves used by opposing Pokemon targeting este Pokémon or its allies are prevented from having an effect.

Aroma Veil.description: Este Pokémon and its allies cannot become affected by Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, or Torment.

Battle Bond.description: If este Pokémon is a Greninja, its Ataque, Ataque Especial, and Velocidad are raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon. This effect can only happen once per battle.

Berserk.description: When este Pokémon has more than 1/2 its maximum PS and takes damage from an attack bringing it to 1/2 or less of its maximum PS, its Ataque Especial is raised by 1 stage. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a efecto secundario removed by the Sheer Force Ability.

Big Pecks.description: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering de este Pokémon Defensa stat stage.

Blaze.description: When este Pokémon has 1/3 or less of its maximum PS, redondeado hacia abajo, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack.

Bulletproof.description: Este Pokémon is immune to bullet moves.

Cheek Pouch.description: If este Pokémon eats a held Berry, it restores 1/3 of its maximum PS, redondeado hacia abajo, in addition to the Berry's effect. Chlorophyll.description: If Sunny Day is active, de este Pokémon Velocidad is doubled. This effect is prevented if este Pokémon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

Clear Body.description: Evita que otros Pokémon reduzcan las características de este Pokémon.

Damp.description: While este Pokémon is active, Explosion, Mind Blown, Misty Explosion, Self-Destruct, and the Aftermath Ability are prevented from having an effect.

Defiant.description: De este Pokémon Ataque is raised by 2 stages for each of its stat stages that is lowered by an opposing Pokemon.

Disguise.description: If este Pokémon is a Mimikyu, the first hit it takes in battle deals 0 neutral damage. Its disguise is then broken, it changes to Busted Form, and it loses 1/8 of its max PS. Confusion damage also breaks the disguise.

Dragonize.description: De este Pokémon Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

Drizzle.description: On switch-in, este Pokémon summons Rain Dance.

Drought.description: On switch-in, este Pokémon summons Sunny Day.

Fur Coat.description: La Defensa de este Pokémon se duplica.

Gale Wings.description: If este Pokémon is at full PS, its Flying-type moves have their prioridad increased by 1.

Gluttony.description: When este Pokémon is holding a Berry that usually activates with 1/4 or less of its maximum PS, it is eaten at 1/2 or less of its maximum PS instead.

Keen Eye.description: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering de este Pokémon accuracy stat stage. Este Pokémon ignores a target's evasiveness stat stage.

Klutz.description: De este Pokémon held item has no effect. Este Pokémon cannot use Fling successfully. Macho Brace, Power Anklet, Power Band, Power Belt, Power Bracer, Power Lens, and Power Weight still have their effects.

Leaf Guard.description: If Sunny Day is active, este Pokémon cannot become affected by a non-volatile problema de estado or Yawn, and Rest will fail for it. This effect is prevented if este Pokémon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

Levitate.description: Este Pokémon is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability. The effects of Gravity, Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball nullify the immunity. Thousand Arrows can hit este Pokémon as if it did not have this Ability.

Light Metal.description: De este Pokémon weight is halved, redondeado hacia abajo to a tenth of a kilogram. This effect is calculated after the effect of Autotomize, and before the effect of Float Stone. A Pokemon's weight will not drop below 0.1 kg.

Lightning Rod.description: Este Pokémon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Ataque Especial by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move. Magic Bounce.description: Este Pokémon is unaffected by certain non-damaging moves directed at it and will instead use such moves against the original user. Moves reflected in this way are unable to be reflected again by this or Magic Coat's effect. Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes can only be reflected once per side, by the leftmost Pokemon under this or Magic Coat's effect. The Lightning Rod and Storm Drain Abilities redirect their respective moves before this Ability takes effect.

Magic Guard.description: Este Pokémon can only be damaged by direct attacks. Curse and Substitute on use, Belly Drum, Pain Split, Struggle recoil, and confusion damage are considered direct damage.

Magician.description: If este Pokémon has no item, it steals the item off a Pokemon it hits with an attack. Does not affect Doom Desire and Future Sight. If multiple targets are hit by an attack the item is stolen from the fastest Pokemon, while considering the effect of Trick Room and prioritizing opposing Pokemon before allies.

Magma Armor.description: Este Pokémon cannot be frozen. Gaining this Ability while frozen cures it.

Marvel Scale.description: If este Pokémon has a non-volatile problema de estado, its Defensa is multiplied by 1.5.

Mega Launcher.description: De este Pokémon pulse moves have their power multiplied by 1.5. Heal Pulse restores 3/4 of a target's maximum PS, redondeado hacia abajo.

Mold Breaker.description: De este Pokémon moves and their effects ignore certain Abilities of other Pokemon. The Abilities that can be negated are Armor Tail, Aroma Veil, Aura Break, Battle Armor, Big Pecks, Bulletproof, Clear Body, Contrary, Damp, Dazzling, Disguise, Dry Skin, Earth Eater, Filter, Flash Fire, Flower Gift, Flower Veil, Fluffy, Friend Guard, Fur Coat, Good as Gold, Grass Pelt, Guard Dog, Heatproof, Heavy Metal, Hyper Cutter, Ice Face, Ice Scales, Illuminate, Immunity, Inner Focus, Insomnia, Keen Eye, Leaf Guard, Levitate, Light Metal, Lightning Rod, Limber, Magic Bounce, Magma Armor, Marvel Scale, Mind's Eye, Mirror Armor, Motor Drive, Multiscale, Oblivious, Overcoat, Own Tempo, Pastel Veil, Punk Rock, Purifying Salt, Queenly Majesty, Sand Veil, Sap Sipper, Shell Armor, Shield Dust, Simple, Snow Cloak, Solid Rock, Soundproof, Sticky Hold, Storm Drain, Sturdy, Suction Cups, Sweet Veil, Tangled Feet, Telepathy, Tera Shell, Thermal Exchange, Thick Fat, Unaware, Vital Spirit, Volt Absorb, Water Absorb, Water Bubble, Water Veil, Well-Baked Body, White Smoke, Wind Rider, Wonder Guard, and Wonder Skin. This affects every other Pokemon on the field, whether or not it is a target of de este Pokémon move, and whether or not their Ability is beneficial to este Pokémon.

Moody.description: Este Pokémon has a random stat, other than accuracy or evasiveness, raised by 2 stages and another stat lowered by 1 stage at the end of each turn.

Motor Drive.description: Este Pokémon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Velocidad by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move.

Moxie.description: De este Pokémon Ataque is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon.

Multiscale.description: If este Pokémon is at full PS, damage taken from attacks is halved.

Natural Cure.description: Este Pokémon has its non-volatile problema de estado cured when it se retira.

No Guard.description: Every move used by or against este Pokémon will always hit.

Oblivious.description: Este Pokémon cannot be infatuated or taunted. Gaining this Ability while infatuated or taunted cures it. Este Pokémon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

Opportunist.description: When an opposing Pokemon has a stat stage raised, este Pokémon copies the effect.

Slush Rush.description: If Snow is active, de este Pokémon Velocidad is doubled.
